title: Ancient Lava Tube
description: A natural tunnel stretches into the mountainside, its smooth walls carved by rivers of molten rock long since cooled. The air inside is warm and dry, carrying the faint scent of sulfur. Ridges of hardened obsidian line the passage where the lava once pooled before draining away.

choices.label: Explore deeper
choices.description: Push further into the tunnel where forgotten valuables may have been trapped by the flow.

outcomes.text: The tunnel opens into a chamber where a traveler's camp was frozen in time by the flow. Their coin purse survived, fused to the stone. You pry it free.
A narrow side passage yields a few scattered coins and a shard of obsidian worth keeping.
The tunnel narrows suddenly and the air turns searing. A hidden vent blasts superheated gas into the passage. You scramble back, choking.

choices.label: Harvest cooled obsidian
choices.description: Break free a shard of the obsidian ridges lining the tunnel walls.

outcomes.text: The obsidian cracks cleanly from the wall in a single satisfying piece. Its edges gleam like black glass.
The ridge crumbles more than you expected, but the fragments are still usable. Some ember dust sifts out as well.
A chunk breaks free and slashes across your forearm. The obsidian edge is sharper than any blade.

choices.label: Rest in the warmth
choices.description: The steady heat soothes aching muscles and weary bones.

outcomes.text: You settle against the warm stone walls and let the gentle heat seep into tired muscles. Everyone feels better.
The warmth is pleasant at first, but the sulfur fumes give everyone a headache. Still, some rest is better than none.
You doze off in the warmth, only to wake to a low rumble. The tunnel trembles and dust rains down. As you scramble out, you grab a loose shard from the wall.
